Fudbalski klub Sloga Doboj, also known as Sloga Meridian for sponsorship reasons, is an association football club from the city of Doboj in northern Republika Srpska, an entity of Bosnia and Herzegovina. The club competes in the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina and plays its home matches at Stadion Luke, which has a capacity of 3,000.
